water-accesses.geojson.caveats: In-watershed count 80 (audit bbox estimate was 91). Join key dow_lake_id <-> infested-waters downumber (Leech Lake DOW 11020300).

infested-waters.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
infested-waters.geojson.caveats: In-watershed count 12 (audit bbox estimate was 29; one row per waterbody x species). Leech Lake rows: 3 (Eurasian watermilfoil, designated 2005; zebra mussel, 2016; starry stonewort, 2021), plus 1 Leech Lake River segment row (faucet snail). [Corrected Nov 20, 2026 — the original 'Leech Lake rows: 0' was wrong; verified against the file on disk.] Layer metadata last updated 2017-02-24, ~98% complete as of Jan 2017; cross-check per-lake species claims against the DNR Oct 2026 spreadsheet (dnr.state.mn.us/invasives/ais/infested.html) before publishing.

tributaries.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
tributaries.geojson.caveats: In-watershed count 1289 (audit bbox estimate was 1,483 segments). Named rivers by segment count: Unnamed Stream 103, Boy River 37, Unnamed Creek 37, Necktie River 22, Swift River 18, Sucker Creek 12. NHDPlus HR not used (queries time out from this VM).

reservation.geojson.query: Copied from ITM pull (2026-11-11), not re-fetched; BIA AIAN-LAR LAR0033 'Leech Lake'
reservation.geojson.caveats: BIA GISACRES attribute (1,794,106 ac) contradicts its own geometry (~823k ac geometry-measured) and is NOT used. Census TIGER 1940R is the cross-check; DNR 1973 review service is dead.

water-quality-stations.geojson.query: where latest_sampling_year >= '2015', geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon simplified to 100 m (see caveats), spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
water-quality-stations.geojson.caveats: FILTER (documented judgment call, audit open Q4; Paul may override): latest_sampling_year >= 2015, all types. Unfiltered in-watershed count 622; filtered 217. Audit bbox estimate was 726 unfiltered. CLIP CAVEAT: this service rejects the full 4,743-vertex HUC8 polygon ('geometry' parameter is invalid), so the clip used is the HUC8 polygon simplified to 100 m (734 vertices). Tolerance sensitivity on the unfiltered count: 100 m 622, 500 m 623, 1000 m 622 -- at most one boundary station differs. Envelope (bbox) count re-verified live: 726.

parcels.geojson.query: where 1=1 per county service, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; geometry simplified Douglas-Peucker ~7 m; attribute-empty records dropped
parcels.geojson.caveats: FENCE: safe fields only (PIN, acres, plat/lot/block, PLSS section/township/range, use class, ownership, school district, watershed district + source_county/source_dataset). NO owner/taxpayer/address/EMV/tax/sale/homestead fields were requested or stored. Property situs address excluded. File is OFF by default in the viewer; ~20 MB scale needs a zoom gate / load plan before publishing (audit Q17). GREP NOTE (Nov 20 verification): a raw substring grep of the file hits 'tax'/'homestead'/'sale'/'owner' ONLY inside approved-field VALUES, never as field names: use_class labels such as 'Tax Forfeited County Administered/PILT' (2,021 features) and 'Homesteaded Resort' (110), the plat name 'Salem Lutheran Evangelical Cemetery' (1), the source_dataset strings naming the county 'Tax Parcels' services, and the approved 'ownership' field name itself. Zero delinquent/EMV/address values; no owner_name/tax_name/PINAME/OWNERNAME/emv_*/total_tax/sale_*/homestead/address fields were requested or stored.

wimn-sites.geojson.caveats: MPCA What's in My Neighborhood (WIMN) sites, queried by the service's own huc8 attribute (not a polygon clip); watershed_name LIKE '%Leech%' returns the same 812, cross-checked live. This is a SITES database, not a live spill feed: it lists contaminated properties (under investigation and already cleaned up), petroleum tank leak sites, landfills, hazardous-waste sites, permitted/registered facilities, penalized facilities, and emergency-management activities (where spill responses appear). Agricultural-chemical spills are the Dept. of Agriculture's separate database, not MPCA. Listing does not imply a current threat. Every popup links back via site_url to the MPCA WIMN page for that site. One site inside the polygon carries NULL huc8/watershed_name in the service, so the attribute query misses it; it was appended 2026-11-21 after a live fetch of its full record plus the spatial-clip check -- 'Anderson Brothers Construction Co Base 6' (site_id 84, 5 miles S of Hackensack, Cass County, -94.4716, 46.9465; Multiple Activities / Multiple Programs; https://webapp.pca.state.mn.us/wimn/site/84). A spatial clip returns 813 vs 812 by attribute; no attribute-query site falls outside the polygon. Coordinates for this site are a zip-code centroid in the service record.

bathymetry-contours.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
bathymetry-contours.geojson.caveats: DNR lake bathymetry contours (MapServer only -- the FeatureServer endpoint on this service errors HTTP 500). Contour interval 5 ft (abs_depth 0..200 ft in 5-ft steps; 10-ft spacing below ~110 ft in some lakes). depth is negative feet below surface (0 at shore); abs_depth is the positive magnitude. Deepest contour in the watershed: -200 ft. Leech Lake contours are split by basin (Main Basin DOW 11020301, Kabekona Bay 11020302).

bathymetry-outlines.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
bathymetry-outlines.geojson.caveats: DNR lake bathymetry outlines (MapServer only). 85 distinct lakes/basins with bathymetry in the watershed. Islands are separate features (island='Y') sharing the lake dowlknum. Metadata (survey date/map/source, layer 2) joined onto outlines by dowlknum on 76 of 144 features; 0 metadata records had no matching outline. Leech Lake survey: map B0050, fieldwork ended 7/18/1957, source 'ORIG MAP'.

impaired-lakes.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
impaired-lakes.geojson.caveats: MPCA Impaired Waters 2024 final (303(d) list) -- NOT the 2026 draft. Layers 13 (impaired lakes) and 12 (impaired lakes partially within reservations) merged into one file; in_reservation='Y' marks layer-12 features. Leech Lake Main Basin 11-0203-01 cat 4A Hg-F lives in layer 12, not 13. cat is the IR category (4A = TMDL approved, 5 = impaired, needs TMDL); imp_param lists impairment parameters; per-pollutant columns (hg_f, nutrients, ...) carry the year the impairment was listed, not a Y/N flag.

impaired-streams.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
impaired-streams.geojson.caveats: MPCA Impaired Waters 2024 final (303(d) list). Kabekona River 07010102-511 is cat 5 E. coli in this 2024 final; the 2026 draft drops it (delisting pending) -- publish with a pop-up note 'Kabekona E. coli delisting pending in 2026 draft'.

assessed-streams.geojson.caveats: MPCA Assessed Waters 2024 -- every assessed stream reach in the watershed. Same per-use support fields as assessed lakes, plus lrv (limited resource value).

fcmp-fish-tissue.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
fcmp-fish-tissue.geojson.caveats: MPCA Fish Contaminant Monitoring Program (FCMP) fish-tissue results. ROWS ARE PER-SAMPLE-PER-CHEMICAL, not sites: one fish sample yields several rows (one per chemical analysed); 2111 rows across 43 distinct station ids and 34 waterbodies. The earlier synthesis fetch hit the server transfer limit at ~982 rows; this pull paginates by objectid (count -> ids -> chunk fetch -> recount) and the feature count matches the live returnCountOnly count (2111). waterbody is kept verbatim: Leech Lake is 'Leech (Main Basin)', not 'Leech Lake' -- a join on lake name needs normalising. detect_flag / detection limits carried per row; result_value_type distinguishes measured vs estimated values. 0 rows have no point geometry (station lat/lon attributes retained as fallback).
